div.head: Northu 64
div.ab: Gif hwa his rihtæwe lifigende forlæte ⁊ on oðran wife on unriht gewifige, næbbe he Godes myldse, buton he hit gebete.
Gif hwa his rihtæwe lifigende forlæte and on oðran wife on unriht gewifige, næbbe he Godes myldse buton he hit gebete.
If anyone abandons a living legal wife, and wrongly takes to wife another woman, may he not have God’s mercy, unless he atones for it.
If anyone deserts his living lawful wife and wrongfully weds another woman, let him not receive God's mercy unless he does penance for it.
Wenn einer seine lebende Ehefrau verlässt und sich mit einem anderen Weibe unrechtmässig beweibt, erhalte er Gottes Gnade nicht, ausser wenn er es büsst.
If anyone leaves his lawful wife while she is living and wrongfully marries another woman, let him not have God's mercy, unless he atones for it.
div.note: Liebermann compares VI Atr 5.2.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘And if anyone abandons a living legal wife, and wrongly takes to wife another woman, may he not have God's mercy, unless he atones for it.’).
